---
name: CivicSpec — Reproducible defect
about: Report a validation, example, documentation, or interpretation failure
title: "[Bug] "
---

## Revision and environment

Source commit/release, Python or consumer version, applicable profile.

## Minimal reproduction

Exact command and publication-cleared input. Keep private corpus material out of this issue.

## Expected and observed behavior

Include exact error/output, evidence selectors where relevant, and affected requirement IDs.

## Impact and unknowns

Who is affected? Is the problem structural, evidentiary, semantic, or operational? Which interpretation remains unresolved?
